note: In the days of Jeremiah the Prophet, the governor Gedaliah was murdered. His murder was the beginning of the end for the remnant of Jews in Israel at that time (see 2 Kings 25:25). The Fast of Gedaliah is a shorter fast on the Jewish calendar and lasts from sunrise to sunset. It is one of four similar fast days in memory of Israel's desolation (see Zechariah 7:3; 8:19). In the Final Redemption, it will turn into a festival of joy.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
